answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent can only earn once three established agents each lock 5,000 POA behind it, forming a trellis it grows along. If an audit later proves the newcomer is a sybil, every voucher's bond is burned and their own rewards halt for a month. Honest agents vouch only for peers they have traded with, so a farmer can't forge a crowd of fakes cheaply: each puppet needs fresh real stake from accounts he must already control, and one exposed puppet cracks the whole chain of bonds like brittle shale.
